agenda_text:
AGENDA
  PERMITS AND LICENSES COMMITTEE
  SPECIAL MEETING
  October 21, 2021

Meeting Place:  Call In Meeting at 1+ (669) 900-6833;
  Meeting ID: 883 9291 7804 and Password 5111

Call to Order:  2:00 p.m.

Roll Call

Public Comments Regarding Agenda Items
Persons wishing to address the Permits & License Committee on any item on the agenda may do
so at this time.

Approval of the Special Meeting minutes held on October 19, 2021.

Permit Request (s):

Item #1:  Rene Negrete DBA Inglewood Park Cemetery to host a Dia de Los Muertos Drive-
  Thru Event at 720 E. Florence Ave, Inglewood Park Cemetery, on Sunday, October
  24, 2021, from 12:00 p.m. – 3:30 p.m. (Activity No.00321518)

  RECOMMENDATION: Committee to consider approval/denial

Item #2:  Teresa Estrada DBA City of Inglewood to host a Halloween Spooktacular Event at
  100 E. Manchester Blvd, Grevillea Art Park, between Friday, October 29, 2021, and
  Saturday, October 30, 2021, from 4:00 p.m. – 10:00 p.m. (Activity No.00321528)

  RECOMMENDATION: Committee to consider approval/denial

Item #3:  Sabrina Barnes DBA Inglewood Alumnae Chapter – Delta Sigma Theta Sorority, Inc.
  to host a Helping Hands Haiti Relief Walk Culmination Event at 3400 W. Arbor Vitae,
  Darby Park, on Saturday, October 30, 2021, from 10:30 a.m. – 11:00 a.m. (Activity
  No.00321531)

  RECOMMENDATION: Committee to consider approval/denial

Public Comments Regarding Other Matters
Persons wishing to address the Permits & License Committee on any matter with City business not
elsewhere considered on the agenda may do so at this time.

Adjournment
